{{Quote|Master Kyle Katarn succumbed to [the Dark Force Temple]. He was brought back to the light side of the Force only by his pupil.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FotJ" />}}
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]] undertook a mission to '''rescue Kyle Katarn''' after he disappeared in the [[Dark Force Temple]] on the forgotten [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]].

==Background==
{{Quote|Try to stay out of trouble, Kyle...|Mara Jade, as Katarn left alone for the Dark Force Temple|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
[[File:DarkForce.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Force Temple]]
In [[10 ABY/Legends|10 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] and his [[Reciprocal apprenticeship|co-Jedi learner]], [[Mara Jade Skywalker|Mara Jade]],<ref name="DF1">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050407a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 1}}</ref> trained at the [[Altyr V base|New Republic base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Altyr V]].<ref name="MOTS" /> While there, Katarn discovered ancient runes that led to [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]],<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|I|210|Dromund Kaas}}</ref> a long-forgotten [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] planet.<ref name="Essential">''[[The New Essential Guide to Characters]]''</ref> 

Following the [[Battle of Altyr V (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Altyr V]], Katarn departed for the dark world aboard a stolen [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle|Imperial shuttle]].<ref name="MOTS" /> His absence left the New Republic without a key [[Officer/Legends|officer]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War's]] latest [[Operation Shadow Hand|Imperial attack]],<ref name="TNEC" /> and Katarn's departure also cut Jade's and his mutual [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] training short. Jade filled Katarn's governmental role by [[Mission to negotiate supplies from Ka'Pa the Hutt|negotiating]] with a [[Hutt]] for supplies and [[Seizure of the Jedi holocron|saving]] a stolen [[Kaerobani's holocron|Jedi holocron]] from [[Lumini pirates/Legends|pirates]], further honing her Jedi abilities. However, Jade grew concerned about Katarn as he had not communicated for some [[Time/Legends|time]], so she resolved to travel to Dromund Kaas herself to find him. Meanwhile, her friend and fellow Jedi journeyed deep into Dromund Kaas' [[Dark Force Temple]] and succumbed to its influences; Katarn had fallen to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Facing the Dark Force Temple==
{{Quote|I know your intentions are to save me Mara...but it's far too late now.|Kyle Katarn, to Mara Jade|<ref name="MOTS" />}}
[[File:Sith_Jedi.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Sith Jedi statue guardians fed on an intruder's Force connection.]]
Landing in a [[Swamp/Legends|swamp]] clearing near the Dark Force Temple, Jade found all of her weapons except her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] rendered unusable as she ventured toward the Dark Force Temple. She used a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to move past the [[Unidentified Sith statues|Sith statues]] and fought her way through deadly local wildlife, including [[dart flower]]s, [[Mailoc]]s, [[swamp wampa]]s, and mutant [[water cyc]]s before encountering a Force-manifested dark side [[Dark Mara|doppelgänger]] of herself. After defeating the apparition, Jade reached the Temple, where she battled [[Sithspawn/Legends|mutated]] [[Noghri/Legends|Noghri]], lightsaber-wielding [[Sith Jedi Statue]]s, and [[vornskr]]s that guarded the ruins.<ref name="MOTS" />

Eventually, she found Katarn meditating on a floating dais, above a chasm suffused with the Temple's power. [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Corrupted by the dark side]], Katarn rejected Jade's offer of rescue and attacked her with [[Force Destruction|Dark force energy]] as he retreated deeper into the catacombs. Jade pursued Katarn into the Sith burial chambers, where she fought reanimated [[Sith undead]] warriors.<ref name="MOTS" /> Katarn lured Jade down into the heart of the Temple before he attacked,<ref name="MOTS" /> fueled by the [[Vergence/Legends|dark side nexus]] of the Temple.<ref name="FotJ" /> Rather than engage him in a duel, she put down her weapon and surrendered to Katarn's mercy. Unable to [[Death/Legends|kill]] his friend, Katarn deactivated his [[Yun's lightsaber|lightsaber]] and returned to the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side of the Force]]. Together again, Jade and Katarn left Dromund Kaas aboard her [[Alpha-52 starfighter|starfighter]], the [[Shrike (Alpha-52 starfighter)|Shrike]].<ref name="MOTS" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|That's an extremely dangerous place. And very, very strong with the dark side.|Luke Skywalker|<ref name="FotJ" />}}
[[File:Dromund Kaas temple.jpg|thumb|left|200px|The Dark Force Temple lingered like a scar.]]
Katarn realized that he and Jade could not continue their reciprocal apprenticeship without a more experienced teacher.<ref name="Essential" /> The events at the Dark Force Temple left Katarn shaken and unwilling to wield his lightsaber,<ref name="TNEC" /> but he eventually accepted [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] tutelage and joined the [[New Jedi Order]],<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|kylekatarn|Katarn, Kyle}}</ref> once the [[Battle of Onderon (Galactic Civil War)|Battle of Onderon]] concluded and Skywalker opened his [[Jedi Praxeum]].<ref name="TNEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> After learning of the planet's dark history,<ref name="DS5">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/article/sw20050609a|series=The Dark Forces Saga|text=Part 5: Two Peas in a Pod}}</ref> Skywalker decided to keep Dromund Kaas's location a secret to prevent its dark power from corrupting other Jedi.<ref name="TCSWE" />


In [[44 ABY]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Luke Skywalker, [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Ben Skywalker]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]], and [[Sith Saber]] [[Vestara Khai]] journeyed to the Temple in search of the Force entity [[Abeloth]] and discussed how Jade saved Katarn, that even a powerful Jedi may be twisted by the nexus of the Dark Force Temple.<ref name="FotJ" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We remembered how both Obi-Wan and Luke had dropped their defenses and sacrificed themselves in their conflict with Vader (who had been corrupted by the dark side, as Kyle had.)  We realized that we had a great hook for our final battle-players would have to surrender to the possibility of utter defeat, power down their lightsabers, and draw on the goodness that was still within Kyle.|Ryan Kaufman|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|RyanKaufman|4|Kyle and Mara: Making Mysteries of the Sith - Part II: Zombies of the Dark Side}}</ref>}}
The mission to Dromund Kaas first appeared in the [[1998]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Mysteries of the Sith]]''.<ref name="MOTS" /> Developers [[Ryan Kaufman (real person)|Ryan Kaufman]] and [[Tim Longo]] designed the series of game levels to test the player's puzzle-solving and lightsaber skills, introducing all-new challenges and enemies. 

[[File:Luke-trial.png|thumb|right|200px|Jade's duel against her shadow mirrored Luke's against the Dark Spirit.]]
The confrontations with Dark Mara and later with "Dark" Katarn paralleled Luke Skywalker's duel with the [[Dark Spirit]] on the planet [[Dagobah]] and his [[Battle of Endor/Legends#Demise of the Sith|final confrontation]] with [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]], in which he surrendered his [[Luke Skywalker's green lightsaber/Legends|blade]], just as Jade would have to do to save Katarn.<ref name="Blog" />
